title: Gas report - Week 28
summary:
LNG
The LNG market strengthened this week, with an influx of cargoes and a tightening position list providing support across most routes. Increased enquiry helped improve sentiment, particularly in the Atlantic basin. On the BLNG1 Australia-Japan route, rates remained relatively stable, easing by $400 week-on-week to settle at $70,900/day.

children.title: LPG
children.summary: The LPG market strengthened this week as fixing activity increased, and the position list began to tighten. While arbitrage economics remain a key factor for sentiment, the improvement in enquiry helped support rates across the major VLGC routes.
